about_the_game:
💾 Chud Logic's: Gockbound

A cursed RPG about e-drama, bad takes, and one man's desperate quest to find his leaked DMs.

Chud Logic's: Gockbound is a darkly comedic, story-driven, turn-based RPG parody set in a warped world inspired by the YouTube commentary scene. After getting isekai’d into a dimension shaped by livestreams, beefs, and algorithmic hell, commentary streamer Chud Logic must fight his way through chaos to escape.

His only hope? Recovering his leaked DMs and reaching the mythical Princess Gock — the only one who can send him home (or cancel him forever).

 Features:

  • Classic Turn-Based Combat meets hot takes and cursed internet energy

  • Search for Leaked DMs across bizarre regions like Ratio Ravine and Simp City

  • Find Princess Gock, the key to redemption (and possibly more drama)

  • Story-Driven Adventure filled with satire, cringe, and cursed lore

  • Retro 2D Pixel Art that blends charm with digital decay

  • A Cast of Questionable Characters including friends, rivals, and lolcows.

Whether you're a terminally online enjoyer of YouTube drama or just into offbeat RPGs with heart, Gockbound offers a chaotic dive into commentary culture.

Note: This is a parody game. Real figures are used satirically and do not imply endorsement
